description: Two languages that both have a Swiss regional catalog, so a LEADING wildcard range ('*-CH') survives into a candidate list spanning two primary languages, and an ANCHORED wildcard ('de-*') survives into a two-locale list whose configured tiebreaker order is deliberately NOT list order. preferredLocaleForWildcard consults the FALLBACK LANGUAGE's tiebreaker list and then falls to the first candidate; preferredLocaleForRange consults the RANGE's primary-language tiebreaker list and then the fallback locale and then the first candidate. Here those two rules pick different locales for both shapes, which is what makes DefaultStrings.matchFor:1845 observable.
